businesses.business: cloud collaboration and file storage software

primary_products.value: cloud file storage and sync software; document sharing and collaboration software; electronic signature software; document workflow tools; AI-powered search software

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers and freelancers on personal plans; B2B: teams, small and mid-sized businesses and enterprises

end_markets.value: consumer productivity; professional services; creative and media; technology; enterprise collaboration

revenue_model.value: subscription: paid recurring plans for storage, collaboration, e-signature and document tools

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and hosts cloud storage and collaboration platform, sold to individuals and organizations

geography_served.value: global: Users worldwide, with the largest base in the US and offices in Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: file storage, document workflow, e-signature and AI search tools
